big.body: A new package is proposed overnight in Antalya. Delegates get until 03:00 GMT to object; the vote is set for 06:00 GMT. The draft still omits fossil fuels.
Red Bull take a 1–2 under the Las Vegas lights. Hadjar is P2 after a final-corner pass on Russell, who takes P3.
Russia fires 496 drones and 53 missiles at Ukraine in one night. At least 5 killed, 10 hurt; a family of four dies in the Lviv region.
